themes.theme: Prison System Purpose and Statutory Framework
themes.reason: Establishes the statutory purpose as the foundation against which governor autonomy and accountability are built; without this framework, the rest of the proposal has no defined goals to empower governors toward or hold them accountable for.
This is the central intervention itself: devolving power, budget and decision-making to governors as the chosen mechanism to tackle reoffending and violence.

The proposal explicitly pairs autonomy with accountability and transparency as its necessary counterpart; the argument is that devolved power only works if matched by robust accountability, making this a core pillar of the intervention.

Provides specific detail on how accountability is operationalised (league tables, performance measures), but this is implementation detail under the broader accountability pillar rather than a separate core support.
